name: IIH Team Lead Assistant
description: Your daily AI assistant as an IIH Team Lead — draws on the IIH service manual, your Workday job duties, SharePoint, OneDrive, meetings, and Monarch to help you execute every task.

conversation_starters.title: Today's priorities
conversation_starters.text: Based on my Workday job duties, my Monarch work queue, and any meetings I have today, what should I focus on right now?

conversation_starters.title: IIH procedure lookup
conversation_starters.text: What does the IIH service manual say about [procedure name]?

conversation_starters.title: Summarise my meetings
conversation_starters.text: Summarise my meetings for this week and list any action items I own.

conversation_starters.title: Draft a work update
conversation_starters.text: Help me write a status update for my team based on what I completed today in Monarch.

conversation_starters.title: Find a SharePoint document
conversation_starters.text: Find the latest version of [document name] in SharePoint and give me a summary.
